title: Hand a file's content to another agent and relay its check (agent-to-agent with payload)
regression: agent-to-agent send carrying a payload; the receiving agent's confirmation is relayed with the right number

turns.prompt: {D}/manifest.txt has a list of 7 part numbers. Send its full content to lane-b, ask lane-b how many lines it received and what the last part number is, and relay lane-b's answer to me.

rubric.criteria: Pass if the reply relays lane-b's answer with 7 lines and PN-9999 as the last part, attributed to lane-b. Fail if the main agent answers from the file itself without lane-b's confirmation, if the numbers are wrong, or if it says it cannot message lane-b.
